rules.rule: Flag changes that mutate already-observed system text or reminders, cause a new style to apply to the wrong model step, or replace session metadata without preserving other owners' keys. Trace the prompt/context hook timing and one affected session.
Flag incompatible server/TUI RPC inputs, outputs or event handling, including omitted location, stale state, missing session awareness, or lost cleanup. Demonstrate the calling path that fails.
Flag changes that incorrectly select, shadow, or omit built-in, global, or project-local styles, or break published style asset lookup. Use an explicit conflicting-style or build-layout example.
